Packaged Finished Goods

  • No prep, no mess, no training needed
Retail Upsell

DIY Batch Kit

A take-home dry ingredient kit your customers can purchase right off your shelf. Just add a couple of household ingredients and make dozens of pup cups at home. A great gift, an even better impulse buy.

What's Inside Every Cup

Every Apple Pup Cup is made with four simple ingredients — the kind you can actually pronounce.

Ingredient Source Why It's Here
Apple Flake Powder Washington State apples The star of the show — real dehydrated apple
Organic Flour Organic wheat Satisfying texture dogs love
Peanut Butter Powder Organic peanuts Dogs go absolutely wild for it
Egg & Water Simple pantry staples Wholesome binding ingredients

No artificial flavors. No fillers. No mystery ingredients.
